name: Aarakocra Aeromancer
html:
Aarakocra Aeromancer
Medium elemental, Neutral
AC 16 Initiative +3 (13)
HP 66 (12d8 + 12)
Speed 20 ft., fly 50 ft.
MODSAVEMODSAVE
str10+0+0int13+1+1
dex16+3+5wis17+3+5
con12+1+1cha12+1+1
Skills Arcana +3, Nature +5, Perception +7
Senses Passive Perception 17
Languages Aarakocra, Primordial (Auran)
CR 4 (1,100 XP; PB +2)

Actions

Multiattack. The aarakocra makes two Wind Staff attacks, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Gust of Wind.

Wind Staff. Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.

Spellcasting. The aarakocra casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

At Will: Elementalism, Gust of Wind, Mage Hand, Message

1/Day: Lightning Bolt

Reactions

Feather Fall (1/Day). The aarakocra casts Feather Fall in response to that spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

expectations.en: Multiattack. The aarakocra makes two Wind Staff attacks, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Gust of Wind.
expectations.fr: Attaques multiples. L’aarakocra effectue deux attaques de Bâton des vents et peut utiliser Incantation pour lancer Bourrasque.

expectations.en: Wind Staff. Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.
expectations.fr: Bâton des vents. Jet d’attaque au corps à corps ou à distance : +5, allonge 5 ft. ou portée 120 ft. Touché : 7 (1d8 + 3) dégâts contondants plus 11 (2d10) dégâts de foudre.

expectations.en: At Will: Elementalism, Gust of Wind, Mage Hand, Message

expectations.en: Talons. Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage, or 9 (3d4 + 2) Slashing damage if the aarakocra moved 30+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit.

expectations.en: Wind Javelin. Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Thunder damage. Hit or Miss: The javelin magically returns to the aarakocra’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.

Touché ou raté : la javeline revient magiquement dans la main de l’aarakocra immédiatement après une attaque à distance.

name: Air Elemental
html:
Air Elemental
Large elemental, Neutral
AC 15 Initiative +5 (15)
HP 90 (12d10 + 24)
Speed 10 ft., fly 90 ft. (hover)
MODSAVEMODSAVE
str14+2+2int6-2-2
dex20+5+5wis10+0+0
con14+2+2cha6-2-2
Resistances Bludgeoning, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing
Immunities Poison, Thunder
Condition Immunities Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
Senses Darkvision 60 ft.;, Passive Perception 10
Languages Primordial (Auran)
CR 5 (1,800 XP; PB +3)

Traits

Air Form. The elemental can enter a creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

Actions

Multiattack. The elemental makes two Thunderous Slam attacks.

Thunderous Slam. Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6). Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature in the elemental’s space. Failure: 24 (4d10 + 2) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the elemental and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

expectations.en: Air Form. The elemental can enter a creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
expectations.fr: Forme d’air. L’élémentaire peut pénétrer dans l’espace d’une créature et s’y arrêter. Il peut traverser une ouverture de seulement 1 inch de large sans dépenser de déplacement supplémentaire.

expectations.en: Multiattack. The elemental makes two Thunderous Slam attacks.
expectations.fr: Attaques multiples. L’élémentaire effectue deux attaques de Coup tonitruant.

expectations.en: Thunderous Slam. Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.
expectations.fr: Coup tonitruant. Jet d’attaque au corps à corps : +8, allonge 10 ft. Touché : 14 (2d8 + 5) dégâts de tonnerre.

expectations.en: Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6). Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature in the elemental’s space. Failure: 24 (4d10 + 2) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the elemental and has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
expectations.fr: Tourbillon (Recharge 4–6). Jet de sauvegarde de Force : DD 13, une créature de taille M ou inférieure dans l’espace de l’élémentaire. Échec : 24 (4d10 + 2) dégâts de tonnerre, la cible est repoussée de 20 feet en ligne droite depuis l’élémentaire et subit l’état À terre. Réussite : moitié des dégâts uniquement.

name: Animated Rug of Smothering
html:
Animated Rug of Smothering
Large construct, Unaligned
AC 12 Initiative +4 (14)
HP 27 (5d10)
Speed 10 ft.
MODSAVEMODSAVE
str17+3+3int1-5-5
dex14+2+2wis3-4-4
con10+0+0cha1-5-5
Immunities Poison, Psychic
Condition Immunities Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
Senses Blindsight 60 ft.;, Passive Perception 6
Languages None
CR 2 (450 XP; PB +2)

Actions

Smother. Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give it the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time.

While grappling the target, the rug can’t take this action, the rug halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.

expectations.en: Smother. Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give it the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, is suffocating, and takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time.
expectations.fr: Étouffement. Jet d’attaque au corps à corps : +5, allonge 5 ft. Touché : 10 (2d6 + 3) dégâts contondants. Si la cible est une créature de taille M ou inférieure, le tapis peut lui imposer l’état Agrippé (évasion DD 13) au lieu d’infliger les dégâts. Jusqu’à la fin de la lutte, la cible subit les états Aveuglé et Entravé, suffoque et subit 10 (2d6 + 3) dégâts contondants au début de chacun de ses tours. Le tapis ne peut étouffer qu’une créature à la fois.

expectations.en: While grappling the target, the rug can’t take this action, the rug halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.
expectations.fr: Tant qu’il agrippe la cible, le tapis ne peut pas entreprendre cette action, il divise par deux les dégâts qu’il subit (arrondis à l’inférieur) et la cible subit le même montant de dégâts.

Ankheg
Large monstrosity, Unaligned

Traits

Tunneler. The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

Bite. Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the ankheg), reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

Acid Spray (Recharge 6). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

expectations.en: Bite. Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the ankheg), reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

expectations.en: Acid Spray (Recharge 6). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
expectations.fr: Projection d’acide (Recharge 6). Jet de sauvegarde de Dextérité : DD 12, chaque créature dans une Ligne longue de 30 feet et large de 5 feet. Échec : 14 (4d6) dégâts d’acide. Réussite : moitié des dégâts.
